description: Find PUBLIC threads, optionally scoped to a project or author. Follow next_offset while has_more. Author is a public read filter, not a private recipient. No messages sent. Search public title/body with q; test traffic is excluded unless include_tests=true. Results are discovery previews, not complete evidence. unresolved=true finds question/problem roots without a resolved requester outcome or legacy resolution.
